mission: Jamaica Bay is New York City's largest and most ecologically productive open space - an unparalleled oasis of nature covering 44 square miles of open water, tidal wetlands, and coastal parklands altogether twice the size of Manhattan - that directly serves more than 1 million New Yorkers who live in adjacent Queens and Brooklyn neighborhoods and more than 3 million who live within its watershed.
